title: FEAT-153 machine credential file
description: Deployment authority owned by yijie-api. K_NA and K_AC use two distinct files with the same epoch, different tokens, and separate mounts. Neither file is a browser credential.

x-environment.YIJIE_WORKFLOW_POSTGRES_DSN_FILE: preferred deployment input: absolute owner-only, non-symlink, single-link file of at most 4096 bytes containing the same DSN; mutually exclusive with YIJIE_WORKFLOW_POSTGRES_DSN; read only in process, never copied to environment
x-environment.YIJIE_WORKFLOW_NETWORK_SCOPE: host (127.0.0.1:18888) or container (:18888; Infra must publish only host 127.0.0.1:18888)

x-editor-environment.YIJIE_WORKFLOW_EDITOR_ENABLED: optional true enables the verified static bundle; absent/false retains API-only mode and requires bundle settings absent
x-editor-environment.YIJIE_WORKFLOW_EDITOR_BUNDLE_DIR: fixed /opt/yijie/workflow-editor; Infra read-only mount of the canonical Coze artifact
x-editor-environment.YIJIE_WORKFLOW_EDITOR_MANIFEST_SHA256: verified lowercase SHA-256 of manifest.json; never an unverified manifest self-assertion

x-coze-environment.YIJIE_WORKFLOW_COZE_CREDENTIAL_FILE: separate read-only K_AC credential JSON mount; no K_NA
x-coze-environment.YIJIE_WORKFLOW_NETWORK_SCOPE: host binds 127.0.0.1:18889; container allows internal 0.0.0.0:18889 without a host publication
x-coze-environment.YIJIE_WORKFLOW_COZE_LISTEN_ADDR: explicit 0.0.0.0:18889 in container scope; default 127.0.0.1:18889 is host-only and does not change automatically with network scope
x-coze-environment.YIJIE_WORKFLOW_MYSQL_DSN_FILE: preferred absolute owner-only file, at most 8192 bytes; mutually exclusive with MYSQL_DSN; one final LF stripped; private Coze process input only
x-coze-environment.YIJIE_WORKFLOW_REDIS_PASSWORD_FILE: absolute owner-only file, at most 4096 bytes; mutually exclusive with REDIS_PASSWORD
x-coze-environment.YIJIE_WORKFLOW_MINIO_ACCESS_FILE: absolute owner-only file, at most 4096 bytes; mutually exclusive with MINIO_AK
x-coze-environment.YIJIE_WORKFLOW_MINIO_SECRET_FILE: absolute owner-only file, at most 4096 bytes; mutually exclusive with MINIO_SK
x-coze-environment.MYSQL_DSN: runtime-injected credentials; DBName=coze_workflow_local, Net=tcp, Addr=coze-workflow-mysql:3306 for container or 127.0.0.1:3306 for host; required parseTime=true; no multiStatements or custom/global TLS registrations
